T:P1.1.text: Innovation Driven by Engineering Excellence | Crane Co.

T:P1.2.text: Crane Co. delivers engineered solutions for aerospace, defense, flow technologies, and critical industries—driven by innovation and 170 years of excellence.

T:P1.4.text: Our businesses are driven by proprietary and differentiated technology, proven reliability, deep vertical expertise, and responsiveness to unique customer needs.

T:P1.5.text: Redefining What’s Possible in Mission-Critical Innovation.

T:P1.6.text: We push the boundaries of innovation, delivering proprietary solutions that set new standards for mission-critical performance across aerospace, defense, and other demanding environments.

T:P1.7.text: Engineering Excellence Built for Mission-Critical Challenges.

T:P1.8.text: We deliver highly engineered, proprietary solutions that ensure reliability in mission-critical applications across the harshest environments—from cryogenics and nuclear to pharmaceutical, chemical, and water.

T:P1.10.text: Crane has always been an engineering led company. As our organization continues to mature, we are continuing to refine our approach to innovation and new product development.

T:P1.11.text: “I am resolved to conduct my business in the strictest honesty and fairness; to avoid all deception and trickery; to deal fairly with both customers and competitors; to be liberal and just toward employees; and to put my whole mind upon the business.”

T:P1.12.text: Richard Teller Crane, Founder of Crane Co.

T:P1.13.text: Our strategy is built for durability, innovation, and long-term success.

T:P1.14.text: We believe that attracting and retaining the highest quality people is the best insurance of success.

T:P2.1.text: Crane Co. Process Flow Technologies | Valves, Pumps & Controls

T:P2.2.text: Crane Co. delivers process flow technologies for chemical, energy, water, nuclear, and industrial markets, including valves, pumps, instrumentation, and controls.

T:P2.3.text: Crane’s Process Flow Technologies segment is a global provider of highly engineered products and systems, including sensing, instrumentation, controls, and flow control products. With more than 170 years of engineering excellence and expertise, Crane literally wrote the book on flow control with the introduction of the Flow of Fluids Handbook (TP410) that is still used as a definitive source in the industry.

T:P2.4.text: Today, with proprietary technology, precision engineering, and material science innovation, we are solving our customers’ toughest challenges in mission-critical applications that require high-reliability in many of the harshest and most hazardous environments such as cryogenics, nuclear, pharmaceutical, chemical and petrochemical, and wastewater.

T:P2.5.text: Crane ChemPharma & Energy designs and manufactures a variety of high-performance products for the regulation and control of fluids and gases. Its trusted brands offer customers a complete and innovative product portfolio designed for the most demanding corrosive, erosive, and high purity applications.

T:P2.6.text: Primary industries served include cryogenics, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, chemical and petrochemical processing, and power generation. As an integrated fluid handling solutions provider, Crane ChemPharma & Energy is well equipped to respond to complex global projects with comprehensive product packages and timely proposals to simplify our customers’ supply chain on a local level worldwide.

C:P2.1.text: Investors information overview | The Eastern Company

C:P2.4.text: The Eastern Company manages industrial businesses that design, manufacture and sell unique engineered solutions to industrial markets. We believe Eastern’s businesses operate in industries with long-term macroeconomic growth opportunities. Eastern may pursue acquisitions in industries other than those in which its businesses currently operate if an acquisition presents an attractive opportunity.

C:P2.5.text: Among other things, Eastern monitors financial and operational performance of each of its businesses and instills consistent financial discipline. In addition, Eastern recruits and retains talented managers to operate its businesses. We look for leaders who are accountable, maintain cost discipline, act quickly, and build strong followership.

C:P2.6.text: The Eastern Company consists of Big 3 Precision, Eberhard Manufacturing Company, and Velvac. These businesses design, manufacture and market a diverse product line of custom and standard vehicular and industrial hardware, including turnkey returnable packaging solutions, access and security hardware, mirrors, and mirror-cameras.

C:P2.7.text: Big 3 Products and Big 3 Mold’s turnkey returnable packaging solutions are used in the assembly processes of vehicles, aircraft and durable goods and in the production processes of plastic packaging products, packaged consumer goods and pharmaceuticals. Big 3 Products works with leading manufacturers to design and produce custom returnable packaging to integrate with their assembly processes. Big 3 Mold is a global leader in the design and manufacture of blow mold tools.

C:P2.8.text: Eberhard is a global leader in the engineering and manufacturing of access and security hardware. Eberhard offers rotary latches, compression latches, draw latches, hinges, camlocks, key switches, padlocks, and handles among other products, as well as comprehensive development and program management services for custom electromechanical and mechanical systems designed for specific original equipment manufacturers (“OEMs”) and customer applications. Eberhard’s products are found in an expansive range of applications and products globally.

C:P2.9.text: Velvac is the premier designer and manufacturer of proprietary vision technology for OEMs and aftermarket applications, and a leading provider of aftermarket components to the heavy-duty truck market in North America. Velvac serves diverse, niche segments within the heavy- and medium-duty truck, motorhome, and bus markets.
